name: Ban Chao in the Western Regions
summary: With a few dozen men and local allies, Ban Chao restores Han control over the oasis kingdoms of the Tarim basin over thirty years. In 97, from his seat at Kucha, he sends his officer Gan Ying west to look for Daqin, the Roman empire.

stops.note: Ban Chao is sent west with 36 men.
Ban Chao's men kill the Xiongnu envoys, and the king submits.
His base for the next twenty years.
Ban Chao becomes Protector General of the Western Regions, and in 97 sends Gan Ying west from here.
Ban Chao returns home at seventy and dies a month later.
